title: Epistola Antiochi ad Eustathium
titleEn: The Letter of Antiochus the Monk to Eustathius
authors: Antiochus Monachus (Antiochus of the Laura of Saint Sabas)

columns.grc: [b: B] Ἐπειδήπερ γεγράφηκάς μοι, τίμιε Πάτερ Εὐστάθιε, πολλὴν θλίψιν
columns.en: Since you have written to me, honoured Father Eustathius, that

columns.grc: [b: A] τὰ περὶ αὐτῶν, εἶθ' οὕτως καθυποτάξαι τὰ τῆς
columns.en: the things concerning them, and so thereafter to append the

columns.grc: [b: A] ἐν καιρῷ ἐπισκοπῆς αὐτῶν ἀναλάμψουσι.» Καὶ ταῦτα περὶ
columns.en: in the time of their visitation they shall shine forth.»

columns.grc: [b: A] Μοδέστου οἰκοῦνται καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ τῆς ἐρήμου μοναστήρια.
columns.en: Modestus, the remaining monasteries of the desert also are inhabited.

proseNotes.raw: The moderns among the Greeks call a notable monastery a *laura*, on account of the great throng of men who, for devotion's sake, flow together there after the manner of many waters.
